response.overview: A SCROLL OF KNOWLEDGE. A FORGOTTEN BLOODLINE. A FATE WRITTEN ACROSS THE RIVER.  Fleeing the wrath of King Bamania, a royal soldier and medicine man makes a desperate final stand to save his pregnant lover, sending her across a river in a small boat with their unborn child and a sacred scroll of knowledge. Raised in isolation in Mukash Village where he towers over everyone else the boy grows up unaware of his true heritage until the truth of his birth pulls him back to his parents' kingdom, straight into the path of execution.  Blending mythical folklore with sweeping adventure, Henok Ayele trades urban romance for an epic Ethiopian fable of destiny, unity, and survival.
response.title: Bamakash
